description: Fetch one absolute URL with AgentSearch Web Extract and return it as JSON text: title, clean markdown and/or text, links, meta (status_code, content_type, fetched_at, chars, truncated) and error (null on success). Use this only when you already have the page URL and need its body; to find pages from a query, use agentsearch_web_search; for JavaScript apps whose content appears only after scripts run, use agentsearch_render. Paid tool: needs a wallet key (AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY or POCKET_PRIVATE_KEY) and then pays per call in USDC on Base over x402 through the Pocket Network Agentic Portal, never more than the per-call cap or AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC per session (default $1.00); the result includes the payment receipt and the portal envelope {portal, data}, whose data is untrusted third-party content. With no wallet key it makes no network call and explains how to add one. If AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set, it calls your self-hosted AgentSearch API instead (no payment). Note: the free tier covers search only; this tool needs a wallet key or a self-hosted API. Read-only: not destructive, but it fetches over the network and can hit rate limits.

formats.description: Renderings to return: "markdown" and/or "text" (default: the service's choice).

max_chars.description: Cap on returned characters (1–100000, service default 50000).

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to extract.
